name: Shammah
title: David's Warrior and Commander
summary: Shammah was one of King David's brave warriors mentioned among his heroes. He was from Harar and served faithfully in David's army. He is known as one of the thirty heroes who distinguished themselves in David's service.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among David's Heroes
keyEvents.description: Shammah the Hararite is listed among David's thirty heroes, an elite group of warriors who excelled in battle and faithfully served King David.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Roll of Heroes in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shammah is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles among David's mighty men, confirming his position as a recognized warrior in David's army.

keyEvents.title: Served During David's United Kingdom
keyEvents.description: As part of David's elite warriors, Shammah helped defend and strengthen the united kingdom of Israel during David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Warrior Lineage of the Hararites
keyEvents.description: Shammah belonged to the Hararites, a group or clan that produced several prominent warriors in David's service, including Shammah the Hararite.
